examined_formations.title: REAL_ESTATE_BROWSER_AGENT_DAILY_BACKOFFICE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 房地产销售日常浏览器代理后台执行
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A July 29 paid job hired two people to build a daily browser agent across Gmail, GoHighLevel, Sheets and Docs, proving current willingness to pay for reliable browser action. But Browserbase/Stagehand and adjacent computer-use infrastructure entered a production phase during July-August, while the remaining value is client-specific prompt, authentication, exception and workflow integration rather than a reusable independent operator asset.

examined_formations.title: PERSONAL_JOB_SEARCH_APPLICATION_AGENT
examined_formations.chinese_title: 个人求职搜索与自动投递 Agent
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A September 16 buyer offered $150 for search, matching, resume tailoring, browser application, approval and tracking. Simplify's current Autopilot already opens supported employer portals, tailors the resume, fills and submits applications, while Copilot covers a broad set of application sites; residual coverage depends on employer portals, anti-bot rules and site-specific exceptions.

examined_formations.title: WHATSAPP_ACTION_AGENT_FOR_LEAD_QUALIFICATION_BOOKING
examined_formations.chinese_title: WhatsApp 线索资格判断与预约行动 Agent
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A September 10 buyer offered $1,000 for a production WhatsApp agent that qualifies leads, follows up, books appointments, updates CRM records and triggers workflows. Wati/Astra now publishes the same multi-step WhatsApp-to-CRM and booking flow, so the control surface is already a platform category and the remaining work is customer configuration and integration.

examined_formations.title: AI_VIDEO_AD_PRODUCTION_PIPELINE
examined_formations.chinese_title: AI 短视频广告端到端生产流水线
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A September 3 buyer paid to chain Claude, ElevenLabs, AI video generation, scene assembly and captions into a ready-to-use short-form ad workflow. Creatify and adjacent 2026 platforms already turn product URLs or briefs into scripts, avatars, voice, b-roll, captions and publish-ready variants, while the higher-value remainder still depends on creative judgment and brand-specific iteration.

examined_formations.title: AGENTIC_COMMERCE_CHECKOUT_EXECUTION_INFRASTRUCTURE
examined_formations.chinese_title: Agentic Commerce 自动结账与支付执行基础设施
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current long-term role pays $100-$250/hour to build browser agents, automated ecommerce checkout, merchant integrations and reliable order execution. The workflow is genuinely new and high-value, but Stripe, Visa and Mastercard now expose agentic-commerce discovery, authorization, tokenization and payment primitives, concentrating the decisive trust and payment control surface inside processors and card networks.

examined_formations.title: CLIENT_DOCUMENT_ROUTING_PARSE_DATABASE_AGENT
examined_formations.chinese_title: 客户文档分发、解析与入库 Agent
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A September 10 buyer paid $800 for agents that copy uploaded documents to multiple destinations, summarize them, parse them and write structured data into a database. Zapier already exposes end-to-end document intake, extraction, routing and AI-agent actions across the business stack; the remaining mapping is organization-specific implementation rather than a distinct recurring operator control position.
